items.en: How do you send a document to a coworker far away?
items.yaku: 遠くの同僚に書類を送る方法は何ですか。
items.answer: by email
items.answer_full: You send a document to a coworker far away by email.

items.en: What does a company give you at the end of each month?
items.yaku: 会社が毎月末にくれるものは何ですか。
items.answer: a salary
items.answer_full: A company gives you a salary at the end of each month.

items.en: Who is the person that leads a team at work?
items.yaku: 職場でチームを率いる人は誰ですか。
items.answer: a manager
items.answer_full: The person that leads a team at work is a manager.

items.en: What do you get when you start a job for the first time?
items.yaku: 初めて仕事を始めるときに受けるものは何ですか。
items.answer: training
items.answer_full: When you start a job for the first time, you get training.

items.en: What do you use at the office when there is a fire?
items.yaku: オフィスで火事のときに使うものは何ですか。
items.answer: the stairs
items.answer_full: You use the stairs at the office when there is a fire.

items.en: What do you call one part of a long report?
items.yaku: 長いレポートの一部を何と呼びますか。
items.answer: a section
items.answer_full: One part of a long report is called a section.

items.en: What do you say when a client comes to meet you?
items.yaku: クライアントが会いに来たときに言う言葉は何ですか。
items.answer: hello
items.answer_full: When a client comes to meet you, you say hello.

items.en: What is the paper that shows how much you must pay?
items.yaku: 支払うべき金額が書かれた紙を何と呼びますか。
items.answer: a bill
items.answer_full: The paper that shows how much you must pay is a bill.

items.en: I have to leave now.
items.yaku: もう行かないといけないんだ。
items.answer: I have to leave now.

items.en: Do you want to join us?
items.yaku: 一緒に来る？
items.answer: Do you want to join us?

items.en: Can you give me a hand?
items.yaku: 手伝ってくれる？
items.answer: Can you give me a hand?

items.en: Did you watch the film yesterday?
items.yaku: 昨日その映画見た？
items.answer: Did you watch the film yesterday?

items.en: I can help if you let me.
items.yaku: 手伝えるよ、もしよければ。
items.answer: I can help if you let me.

items.en: I will start when you got it.
items.yaku: 君が準備できたら始めるよ。
items.answer: I will start when you got it.

items.en: Do you know what time it starts?
items.yaku: 何時に始まるか知ってる？
items.answer: Do you know what time it starts?

items.en: We need to go because it's late.
items.yaku: 遅いから行かないと。
items.answer: We need to go because it's late.

items.en: Can you check it when you have time?
items.yaku: 時間があるときに確認してくれる？
items.answer: Can you check it when you have time?

items.en: You like coffee, don't you, if I remember?
items.yaku: コーヒー好きだよね、確か。
items.answer: You like coffee, don't you, if I remember?

items.en: What are you doing if it's raining tomorrow?
items.yaku: 明日雨だったら何するの？
items.answer: What are you doing if it's raining tomorrow?

items.en: Please take it to the office tomorrow morning.
items.yaku: 明日の朝、事務所に持っていってね。
items.answer: Please take it to the office tomorrow morning.

items.en: I will send it to you by email soon.
items.yaku: すぐにメールで送るね。
items.answer: I will send it to you by email soon.

items.en: It was kind of boring at the meeting yesterday.
items.yaku: 昨日の会議、ちょっと退屈だったよ。
items.answer: It was kind of boring at the meeting yesterday.

items.en: I am going to meet them at the park later.
items.yaku: あとで公園で彼らに会うんだ。
items.answer: I am going to meet them at the park later.

items.en: The report has to be ready because of the meeting.
items.yaku: 会議のために報告書を準備しないとね。
items.answer: The report has to be ready because of the meeting.

items.en: What size does she want now?
items.yaku: 彼女は今どのサイズが欲しいですか？
items.answer: medium
items.answer_full: She wants a medium size.
items.a_yaku: 彼女はMサイズが欲しいです。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hi, I bought this shirt yesterday, but it's too small.
dialogue.yaku: こんにちは、昨日このシャツを買ったのですが、小さすぎます。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Do you want a different size or a refund?
dialogue.yaku: 別のサイズにしますか、それとも返金しますか？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I was thinking of getting a refund, but do you have a medium?
dialogue.yaku: 返金を考えていましたが、Mサイズはありますか？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, we have medium. Would you like to exchange it?
dialogue.yaku: はい、Mサイズはあります。交換しますか？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, please. I'll take the medium size. I hope it fits better.
dialogue.yaku: はい、お願いします。Mサイズをもらいます。これで合うといいのですが。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Great, I'll get that for you right away. Please wait a moment.
dialogue.yaku: わかりました、すぐにお持ちしますね。少々お待ちください。

items.en: Who usually takes orders at the cafe?
items.yaku: 普段、カフェで注文を取るのは誰ですか？
items.answer: the waiter
items.answer_full: Usually, the waiter takes our order.
items.a_yaku: 普段はウェイターが注文を取ります。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We're finally at the cafe. It looks busy today with so many people.
dialogue.yaku: やっとカフェに着いたね。今日はとても混んでいるみたい。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, there are many people waiting. Hope we don't wait long.
dialogue.yaku: うん、たくさんの人が待っているね。あまり待たないといいけど。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I wonder if the chef will take our order today, or if it's someone else.
dialogue.yaku: 今日、シェフが注文を取るのか、それとも別の人なのかしら。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Usually, the waiter takes our order, so I think it will be the same today.
dialogue.yaku: 普段はウェイターが注文を取るから、今日もそうだと思うよ。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Alright, let's decide quickly and enjoy our time here with a nice meal.
dialogue.yaku: よし、早く決めて、ここでの時間を素敵な食事で楽しもう。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, let's look at the menu and choose something nice that we both like.
dialogue.yaku: そうだね、メニューを見て、二人が好きなものを選ぼう。

items.en: Where is the nearest train station?
items.yaku: 一番近い駅はどこですか？
items.answer: post office
items.answer_full: The station is next to the post office.
items.a_yaku: 駅は郵便局の隣にあります。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, can you tell me where the nearest train station is?
dialogue.yaku: すみません、一番近い駅がどこか教えていただけますか？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Are you talking about the station near the big park?
dialogue.yaku: 大きな公園の近くの駅のことを言っていますか？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: No, not that one. Is it the one near the library?
dialogue.yaku: いいえ、それではなく、図書館の近くのものですか？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's not the library. The station is next to the post office.
dialogue.yaku: 図書館ではありません。駅は郵便局の隣にあります。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great, I will walk there now. Thank you very much for your help!
dialogue.yaku: よかった、今からそこに歩いて行きます。ご協力ありがとうございます！

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You're welcome! It takes about ten minutes on foot.
dialogue.yaku: どういたしまして！歩いて約10分かかります。

items.en: When is her check-up appointment scheduled?
items.yaku: 彼女の健康診断の予約はいつですか？
items.answer: Friday afternoon
items.answer_full: Her check-up appointment is scheduled for Friday afternoon.
items.a_yaku: 彼女の健康診断の予約は金曜日の午後に予定されています。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'd like to schedule a check-up appointment very soon, if possible.
dialogue.yaku: できればすぐに健康診断の予約をしたいのですが。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We have a slot on Tuesday morning available for check-ups if you like.
dialogue.yaku: 火曜日の朝に健康診断の空きがありますが、いかがですか。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Tuesday morning is difficult for me. Is Friday possible instead?
dialogue.yaku: 火曜日の朝は難しいです。代わりに金曜日は可能ですか？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let me check. Yes, Friday afternoon is open for check-ups.
dialogue.yaku: 確認しますね。はい、金曜日の午後は健康診断の空きがあります。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Friday afternoon works perfectly for me. I'll take it, thank you.
dialogue.yaku: 金曜日の午後は都合が良いです。それでお願いします、ありがとう。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Great, you're all set for a Friday afternoon check-up.
dialogue.yaku: 素晴らしい、金曜日の午後の健康診断で予約が完了しました。

items.en: Which platform is the train arriving at today?
items.yaku: 今日電車が到着するホームはどこですか？
items.answer: platform 4
items.answer_full: The train is arriving at platform 4 today.
items.a_yaku: 電車は今日プラットフォーム4に到着します。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The train is arriving soon. Do you know which platform it is?
dialogue.yaku: 電車がもうすぐ来るね。どのホームか知ってる？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I think it's platform 2, but let me check again to be sure.
dialogue.yaku: プラットフォーム2だと思うけど、もう一度確認してみるね。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Platform 2? I thought someone mentioned it was platform 4 instead.
dialogue.yaku: プラットフォーム2？誰かがプラットフォーム4だと言ってたと思ったけど。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oh, I just checked. It's actually platform 4 today, so we should head there.
dialogue.yaku: あ、今確認したよ。今日は実際にはプラットフォーム4だから、そこに行こう。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Alright, we should go to platform 4 quickly before we miss it.
dialogue.yaku: わかった、プラットフォーム4に急いで行こう、乗り遅れないように。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, let's hurry and make sure we catch the train on platform 4.
dialogue.yaku: うん、急いでプラットフォーム4の電車に乗ろう。

items.en: What time is the meeting on Friday?
items.yaku: 金曜日の会議は何時ですか？
items.answer: 2 PM
items.answer_full: The meeting is at 2 PM on Friday.
items.a_yaku: 会議は金曜日の午後2時です。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Can we reschedule the meeting to Friday? I have a conflict.
dialogue.yaku: 会議を金曜日に変更できますか？予定が重なっています。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I thought we were meeting on Thursday afternoon, but I can adjust.
dialogue.yaku: 木曜日の午後に会う予定だと思っていましたが、調整できます。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but Friday works better for everyone, so let's do that.
dialogue.yaku: はい、でも金曜日の方がみんなにとって都合がいいので、そうしましょう。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Alright, what time on Friday are we meeting? Let me know.
dialogue.yaku: わかりました、金曜日の何時に会いますか？教えてください。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How about 2 PM? Does that suit you and everyone else?
dialogue.yaku: 午後2時はどうですか？それであなたとみんなに大丈夫ですか？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sounds good, I'll block off Friday afternoon and send the invite.
dialogue.yaku: わかりました、金曜日の午後を空けて招待状を送ります。

items.en: What do we have to do when we leave the room?
items.yaku: 部屋を出るときに何をしなければなりませんか?
items.answer: Turn off lights
items.answer_full: You have to turn off the lights.
items.a_yaku: 電気を消す
items.passage: Hello everyone. This is an important notice. We have to save power in our office. You have to turn off the lights when you leave the room. Also, remember to shut down your computer every day. We have to do this to save money. On Fridays, please make sure all windows are closed before leaving. Thank you for your help. Let's work together to make our office more efficient.
items.passage_yaku: 皆さん、こんにちは。これは重要なお知らせです。オフィスで節電をしなければなりません。部屋を出るときは、必ず電気を消してください。また、毎日コンピュータをシャットダウンすることを忘れないでください。これを行うことでお金を節約できます。金曜日には、出る前にすべての窓が閉まっていることを確認してください。ご協力ありがとうございます。オフィスをより効率的にするために一緒に頑張りましょう。

items.en: What do we have to do with our computers every day?
items.yaku: 毎日コンピュータに対して何をしなければなりませんか？
items.answer: Shut down your computer.
items.answer_full: You have to shut down your computer every day.
items.a_yaku: 毎日コンピュータをシャットダウンする。
items.passage: Hello everyone. This is an important notice. We have to save power in our office. You have to turn off the lights when you leave the room. Also, remember to shut down your computer every day. We have to do this to save money. On Fridays, please make sure all windows are closed before leaving. Thank you for your help. Let's work together to make our office more efficient.
items.passage_yaku: 皆さん、こんにちは。これは重要なお知らせです。オフィスで節電をしなければなりません。部屋を出るときは、必ず電気を消してください。また、毎日コンピュータをシャットダウンすることを忘れないでください。これを行うことでお金を節約できます。金曜日には、出る前にすべての窓が閉まっていることを確認してください。ご協力ありがとうございます。オフィスをより効率的にするために一緒に頑張りましょう。

items.en: What should we do on Fridays before leaving?
items.yaku: 金曜日に出る前に何をしなければなりませんか？
items.answer: Close all windows.
items.answer_full: You should close all windows before leaving on Fridays.
items.a_yaku: 金曜日に出る前にすべての窓を閉める。
items.passage: Hello everyone. This is an important notice. We have to save power in our office. You have to turn off the lights when you leave the room. Also, remember to shut down your computer every day. We have to do this to save money. On Fridays, please make sure all windows are closed before leaving. Thank you for your help. Let's work together to make our office more efficient.
items.passage_yaku: 皆さん、こんにちは。これは重要なお知らせです。オフィスで節電をしなければなりません。部屋を出るときは、必ず電気を消してください。また、毎日コンピュータをシャットダウンすることを忘れないでください。これを行うことでお金を節約できます。金曜日には、出る前にすべての窓が閉まっていることを確認してください。ご協力ありがとうございます。オフィスをより効率的にするために一緒に頑張りましょう。

items.en: What colors does the phone come in?
items.yaku: その電話は何色がありますか?
items.answer: Black, white, and blue
items.answer_full: It comes in black, white, and blue.
items.a_yaku: 黒、白、青
items.passage: Our new phone has a lot of features. It has a big screen and a long battery life. You can take great photos with it. The phone also has a fast processor, which makes it very quick to use. It comes in a lot of colors like black, white, and blue. The price is two hundred dollars. You can buy it online or in stores from Monday.
items.passage_yaku: 私たちの新しい電話には多くの機能があります。大きな画面と長いバッテリー寿命があります。それで素晴らしい写真を撮ることができます。この電話には高速プロセッサもあり、とても速く使えます。黒、白、青など多くの色があります。価格は200ドルです。月曜日からオンラインまたは店舗で購入できます。

items.en: How much does the phone cost?
items.yaku: その電話はいくらですか？
items.answer: Two hundred dollars.
items.answer_full: The phone costs two hundred dollars.
items.passage: Our new phone has a lot of features. It has a big screen and a long battery life. You can take great photos with it. The phone also has a fast processor, which makes it very quick to use. It comes in a lot of colors like black, white, and blue. The price is two hundred dollars. You can buy it online or in stores from Monday.
items.passage_yaku: 私たちの新しい電話には多くの機能があります。大きな画面と長いバッテリー寿命があります。それで素晴らしい写真を撮ることができます。この電話には高速プロセッサもあり、とても速く使えます。黒、白、青など多くの色があります。価格は200ドルです。月曜日からオンラインまたは店舗で購入できます。

items.en: When can you buy the phone?
items.yaku: その電話はいつ買えますか？
items.answer: From Monday.
items.answer_full: You can buy the phone from Monday.
items.a_yaku: 月曜日から。
items.passage: Our new phone has a lot of features. It has a big screen and a long battery life. You can take great photos with it. The phone also has a fast processor, which makes it very quick to use. It comes in a lot of colors like black, white, and blue. The price is two hundred dollars. You can buy it online or in stores from Monday.
items.passage_yaku: 私たちの新しい電話には多くの機能があります。大きな画面と長いバッテリー寿命があります。それで素晴らしい写真を撮ることができます。この電話には高速プロセッサもあり、とても速く使えます。黒、白、青など多くの色があります。価格は200ドルです。月曜日からオンラインまたは店舗で購入できます。

items.en: Yuki started her new job on Monday. She was very nervous in the morning. Her manager showed her the office and introduced her to the team. Everyone was friendly and helped her. At lunch, two coworkers invited her to eat with them. In the afternoon, she learned how to use the company computer system. It was difficult at first, but her manager was patient. By the end of the day, Yuki felt much better.
items.yaku: ユキは月曜日に新しい仕事を始めました。朝はとても緊張していました。マネージャーはオフィスを案内し、チームに紹介しました。みんな親切で彼女を助けてくれました。昼食時に、2人の同僚が一緒に食事をしようと誘ってくれました。午後には会社のコンピュータシステムの使い方を学びました。最初は難しかったですが、マネージャーは辛抱強かったです。1日の終わりには、ユキはずっと気持ちが楽になりました。
items.answer: Yuki started her job and met the team.
items.retell: Yuki started her new job on Monday. Her manager introduced her to the team, and coworkers invited her to lunch.
items.retell_min: Yuki started her job and met the team.

items.en: David had to give a presentation to his team on Thursday. He spent two days making his slides. The night before, he practiced in front of a mirror. He was still worried about his English. On Thursday morning, he arrived early and tested the projector. The presentation went well. His team asked good questions, and he answered most of them. His manager said he did a great job.
items.yaku: デイビッドは木曜日にチームにプレゼンをしなければなりませんでした。彼はスライドを作るのに2日間かけました。前夜、鏡の前で練習しました。それでも英語が心配でした。木曜日の朝、彼は早く到着し、プロジェクターをテストしました。プレゼンはうまくいきました。チームは良い質問をし、彼はほとんど答えました。マネージャーは彼が素晴らしい仕事をしたと言いました。
items.answer: David gave a presentation and was praised.
items.retell: David gave a presentation to his team on Thursday. He practiced a lot, and his manager praised him.
items.retell_min: David gave a presentation and was praised.

items.en: On Tuesday, Sara worked from home for the first time. She woke up early and made coffee. When she tried to join the morning video call, her internet stopped working. She called her phone company, but they could not help right away. So she used her phone to join the call instead. The sound was not perfect, but her team understood her. After lunch, the internet came back.
items.yaku: 火曜日に、サラは初めて在宅勤務をしました。早起きしてコーヒーを作りました。朝のビデオ通話に参加しようとしたとき、インターネットが止まりました。彼女は電話会社に連絡しましたが、すぐには助けてもらえませんでした。それで、代わりに電話を使って通話に参加しました。音は完璧ではありませんでしたが、チームは彼女を理解しました。昼食後、インターネットが復旧しました。
items.answer: Sara worked from home and used her phone for calls.
items.retell: Sara worked from home for the first time. Her internet stopped, so she used her phone to join the call.
items.retell_min: Sara worked from home and used her phone for calls.

items.en: What are two advantages and two disadvantages of living in a big city?
items.yaku: 大都市に住むことの利点を2つ、欠点を2つ教えてください。
items.answer: One good thing is there are many job opportunities.
items.answer_full: One good thing is there are many job opportunities. Another is you can find many activities to do. But it can be very noisy. And it is often expensive to live there.
items.a_yaku: 良い点の一つは、多くの仕事の機会があることです。

items.en: What are two advantages and two disadvantages of working from home?
items.yaku: 在宅勤務の利点を2つ、欠点を2つ教えてください。
items.answer: One good thing is you can save time on commuting.
items.answer_full: One good thing is you can save time on commuting. Another is you can work in a comfortable place. But it can be lonely. And it is hard to separate work and home life.
items.a_yaku: 良い点の一つは、通勤時間を節約できることです。

items.en: Tell me two things a person can do to stay healthy.
items.yaku: 健康を保つためにできることを2つ教えてください。
items.answer: One way is to eat fruits and vegetables every day.
items.answer_full: One way is to eat fruits and vegetables every day. It helps because they have vitamins. Another way is to exercise regularly.
items.a_yaku: 一つの方法は、毎日果物と野菜を食べることです。

items.en: What do we call frozen water, ice or paper?
items.yaku: 凍った水は何と呼びますか、アイスかペーパーか。
items.answer: ice
items.answer_full: Frozen water is called ice.

items.en: Where does a very sick person go, a hospital or a store?
items.yaku: とても具合の悪い人はどこに行きますか、病院か店か。
items.answer: a hospital
items.answer_full: A very sick person goes to a hospital.

items.en: Where do you put a letter at home, a mailbox or a fridge?
items.yaku: 家で手紙をどこに置きますか、郵便箱か冷蔵庫か。
items.answer: a mailbox
items.answer_full: You put a letter in a mailbox at home.

items.en: Who brings your food at a restaurant, a waiter or a nurse?
items.yaku: レストランで食事を運んでくれるのは誰ですか、ウェイターか看護師か。
items.answer: a waiter
items.answer_full: A waiter brings your food at a restaurant.

items.en: Who do you see when you feel sick, a doctor or a farmer?
items.yaku: 具合が悪いときに会うのは誰ですか、医者か農家か。
items.answer: a doctor
items.answer_full: When you feel sick, you see a doctor.

items.en: What do you keep water in, a bottle or a box?
items.yaku: 水を入れておくのは何ですか、ボトルか箱か。
items.answer: a bottle
items.answer_full: You keep water in a bottle.

items.en: What do you buy to ride the train, a ticket or a jacket?
items.yaku: 電車に乗るために買うのは何ですか、チケットかジャケットか。
items.answer: a ticket
items.answer_full: To ride the train, you buy a ticket.

items.en: How many minutes are in half an hour, thirty or thirteen?
items.yaku: 30分は何分ですか、30か13か。
items.answer: thirty
items.answer_full: There are thirty minutes in half an hour.

items.en: We could have won if we played better at the park.
items.yaku: もっと上手くプレーしてたら勝てたかもね。
items.answer: We could have won if we played better at the park.

items.en: Would you help me move this when you have some time?
items.yaku: 時間があるときにこれを動かすの手伝ってくれる？
items.answer: Would you help me move this when you have some time?

items.en: Please pick it up from the office when you leave today.
items.yaku: 今日帰るときに事務所から取ってきてね。
items.answer: Please pick it up from the office when you leave today.

items.yaku: 先週誰も注文しなかったから紙がないんだ。
items.answer: We are out of paper because nobody ordered more last week.

items.en: Can you tell him to call me back if he is free?
items.yaku: 彼が暇なら電話するように伝えてくれる？
items.answer: Can you tell him to call me back if he is free?

items.en: You need to turn it on before you use the machine here.
items.yaku: ここで機械を使う前に電源を入れないとね。
items.answer: You need to turn it on before you use the machine here.

items.en: I used to play soccer with my friends when I was a child.
items.yaku: 子どもの頃、友達とサッカーしてたよ。
items.answer: I used to play soccer with my friends when I was a child.

items.en: What did you do last weekend at the park because it was sunny?
items.yaku: 先週末、公園で何したの？天気良かったよね。
items.answer: What did you do last weekend at the park because it was sunny?

items.en: Please feel free to ask for help, not at all a problem anytime.
items.yaku: いつでも気軽に助けを求めてね、全然問題ないよ。
items.answer: Please feel free to ask for help, not at all a problem anytime.

items.en: Please call me as soon as you get to the station tomorrow morning.
items.yaku: 明日の朝、駅に着いたらすぐに電話してね。
items.answer: Please call me as soon as you get to the station tomorrow morning.

items.en: I should have taken an umbrella yesterday because it rained all day long.
items.yaku: 昨日は一日中雨だったから傘を持っていけばよかったな。
items.answer: I should have taken an umbrella yesterday because it rained all day long.

items.en: We have a lot of apples, and we eat them every morning at home.
items.yaku: 家にリンゴがたくさんあって、毎朝食べてるよ。
items.answer: We have a lot of apples, and we eat them every morning at home.

items.en: When did you last see him at the office before he left for vacation?
items.yaku: 彼が休暇に行く前に最後にオフィスで会ったのはいつ？
items.answer: When did you last see him at the office before he left for vacation?

items.en: How did you solve the problem that we discussed last week at the office?
items.yaku: 先週オフィスで話した問題、どうやって解決したの？
items.answer: How did you solve the problem that we discussed last week at the office?

items.en: She is one of the best singers in our town, without any doubt at all.
items.yaku: 彼女は町で一番の歌手の一人だよ、間違いなく。
items.answer: She is one of the best singers in our town, without any doubt at all.

items.en: I would have called you if I knew you were there yesterday at the event.
items.yaku: 昨日イベントにいるって知ってたら電話したのに。
items.answer: I would have called you if I knew you were there yesterday at the event.

items.en: When will the correct item arrive?
items.yaku: 正しい品物はいつ届きますか。
items.answer: tomorrow morning
items.answer_full: It will arrive by tomorrow morning.
items.a_yaku: 明日の朝

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hi, I think there is an issue with my order today.
dialogue.yaku: すみません、今日の注文に問題があると思います。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I am sorry to hear that. Did you receive the wrong item?
dialogue.yaku: 申し訳ありません。違う品物が届きましたか。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, and I really need the right one by this afternoon.
dialogue.yaku: はい、それに今日の午後までに正しいものが要るんです。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I am afraid this afternoon is not possible for the delivery.
dialogue.yaku: 申し訳ありませんが、今日の午後の配達はできません。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. Then could you tell me when it will arrive?
dialogue.yaku: わかりました。ではいつ届くか教えてもらえますか。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It should be delivered by tomorrow morning, without any delay.
dialogue.yaku: 明日の朝までには、遅れずにお届けできるはずです。

items.en: How many days is the shipment delayed?
items.yaku: 出荷は何日遅れていますか？
items.answer: two days
items.answer_full: The shipment is delayed by two days.
items.a_yaku: 出荷は2日遅れています。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We need to discuss the delivery schedule for this week.
dialogue.yaku: 今週の配送スケジュールについて話し合う必要があります。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Did the shipment arrive yesterday as it was originally planned?
dialogue.yaku: 出荷は予定通り昨日到着しましたか？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: No, it didn't arrive yesterday, but it should today.
dialogue.yaku: いいえ、昨日は到着しませんでしたが、今日は到着するはずです。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, is the shipment delayed by one day then, or more?
dialogue.yaku: では、出荷は1日遅れですか、それとももっとですか？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The shipment will be two days late, not just one day.
dialogue.yaku: 出荷は1日ではなく、2日遅れます。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's notify the client about the two-day delay right away.
dialogue.yaku: すぐにクライアントに2日遅れることを通知しましょう。

items.en: What keeps the man busy this afternoon?
items.yaku: 男の人は今日の午後、何で手が離せませんか。
items.answer: a meeting
items.answer_full: He has a meeting this afternoon.
items.a_yaku: 会議

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Can you assist me with the report this afternoon, please?
dialogue.yaku: 今日の午後、レポートを手伝ってもらえますか。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I would like to, but I have a training class today.
dialogue.yaku: 手伝いたいのですが、今日は研修があります。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, I did not know your training class was today.
dialogue.yaku: え、研修が今日だとは知りませんでした。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Actually the training was moved, so now I have a meeting.
dialogue.yaku: じつは研修は移動になって、いまは会議が入っています。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see, so the meeting is what keeps you busy today.
dialogue.yaku: なるほど、今日は会議で手が離せないんですね。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, but I can help you tomorrow morning after that meeting.
dialogue.yaku: はい、でも明日の朝、会議のあとなら手伝えます。

items.en: How many boxes of printer paper will be ordered?
items.yaku: プリンター用紙は何箱注文されますか？
items.answer: five boxes
items.answer_full: They will order five boxes of printer paper.
items.a_yaku: プリンター用紙を5箱注文します。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The printer paper is almost gone again. We need more paper soon.
dialogue.yaku: プリンター用紙がまたほとんどなくなってしまいました。すぐにもっと必要です。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I remember we ordered three boxes of paper last time, right?
dialogue.yaku: 前回、プリンター用紙を3箱注文したのを覚えていますよね？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but we used them up quickly for the project we had.
dialogue.yaku: はい、でもプロジェクトでそれらをすぐに使い切ってしまいました。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Should we get three boxes again, or maybe we need more this time?
dialogue.yaku: また3箱注文するべきですか、それとも今回はもっと必要ですか？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think we should order five boxes this time for future use.
dialogue.yaku: 今回は将来のために5箱注文するべきだと思います。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Alright, I'll go ahead and order five boxes today for us.
dialogue.yaku: わかりました、私たちのために今日5箱注文します。

items.en: What time is the team meeting today?
items.yaku: 今日のチームミーティングは何時ですか？
items.answer: 4 PM
items.answer_full: The team meeting is scheduled for 4 PM today.
items.a_yaku: チームミーティングは今日の午後4時に予定されています。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hi, do you know when the team meeting is today?
dialogue.yaku: こんにちは、今日のチームミーティングが何時か知っていますか？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I thought it was at 2 PM, but let me check.
dialogue.yaku: 2時だと思っていましたが、確認してみます。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks for checking. I have another meeting scheduled at 3 PM.
dialogue.yaku: 確認してくれてありがとう。3時に別のミーティングが予定されています。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Actually, the team meeting is at 4 PM today.
dialogue.yaku: 実際には、今日のチームミーティングは4時です。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, that’s a relief. I can join both meetings.
dialogue.yaku: ああ、それは安心です。両方のミーティングに参加できます。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, you’ll have enough time between the two meetings today.
dialogue.yaku: はい、今日は2つのミーティングの間に十分な時間があります。

items.en: Why is the blue bag being chosen?
items.yaku: なぜ青いバッグが選ばれているのですか？
items.answer: bigger
items.answer_full: The blue bag is being chosen because it's bigger.
items.a_yaku: 青いバッグは大きいので選ばれています。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Are you bringing the blue bag today or the red one?
dialogue.yaku: 今日は青いバッグを持ってくるの？それとも赤いの？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I was thinking of bringing the blue bag. It's bigger.
dialogue.yaku: 青いバッグを持っていこうと思ってた。大きいからね。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, I see. Can you also bring the notebook?
dialogue.yaku: ああ、そうなんだ。ノートも持ってきてくれる？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure, I can bring the notebook. Do you need anything else?
dialogue.yaku: もちろん、ノートを持っていくよ。他に何か必要？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: No, just the notebook is fine. Thanks for bringing it.
dialogue.yaku: いいえ、ノートだけで大丈夫。持ってきてくれてありがとう。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You're welcome. I'll see you at 10 AM then.
dialogue.yaku: どういたしまして。それじゃあ、10時に会いましょう。

items.en: When has the meeting been moved to?
items.yaku: 会議はいつに変更されましたか?
items.answer: Friday
items.answer_full: The meeting has been moved to Friday.
items.a_yaku: 金曜日
items.passage: The meeting has been moved to Friday. It will start at three in the afternoon. We will meet in the main conference room. Please bring your reports. Thank you. Don't forget to prepare your questions. We will discuss important topics. The meeting was originally scheduled for Thursday, but due to scheduling conflicts, it has been rescheduled. Make sure to arrive on time, as we will begin promptly. Refreshments will be provided during the meeting.

items.en: What is the training session going to be about?
items.yaku: 研修会は何についてですか?
items.answer: Customer service
items.answer_full: The training session is going to be about customer service.
items.a_yaku: カスタマーサービス
items.passage: We are going to have a training session on Tuesday. It is going to be about customer service. The session starts at ten in the morning. Please join us in room 101. You will learn a lot. Bring a notebook and pen. We hope you find it useful. The session will last for two hours. Our manager, Mr. Smith, will lead the session. There will be a short break at eleven o'clock.
items.passage_yaku: 火曜日にトレーニングセッションを行います。それはカスタマーサービスについてです。セッションは午前10時に始まります。101号室に参加してください。多くを学ぶことができます。ノートとペンを持参してください。役立つことを願っています。セッションは2時間続きます。マネージャーのスミスさんがセッションをリードします。11時に短い休憩があります。

items.yaku: トレーニングセッションはどこで行われますか？

items.en: Last Friday, our office had a fire drill. The alarm started at ten in the morning. Everyone stopped working and walked to the stairs. We were not allowed to use the elevator. Outside, our manager counted the people in our team. It took about fifteen minutes. Then we went back to our desks.
items.yaku: 先週の金曜日、私たちのオフィスで避難訓練がありました。午前10時にアラームが鳴りました。みんな仕事をやめて階段へ歩いて行きました。エレベーターは使えませんでした。外で、マネージャーがチームの人数を数えました。約15分かかりました。それからデスクに戻りました。
items.answer: Office had a fire drill, and manager counted us.
items.retell: Our office had a fire drill on Friday. Everyone walked to the stairs, and the manager counted us.
items.retell_min: Office had a fire drill, and manager counted us.

items.en: Kenji moved into a new apartment last weekend. His friends helped him carry the boxes. The apartment was small but bright. On Sunday, he tried to build a bookshelf by himself. The instructions were hard to understand, and he put one part in the wrong place. He had to take it apart and start again. It took three hours.
items.yaku: ケンジは先週末に新しいアパートに引っ越しました。友達が箱を運ぶのを手伝ってくれました。アパートは小さいけれど明るかったです。日曜日に、彼は一人で本棚を組み立てようとしました。説明書がわかりにくく、部品を一つ間違った場所に置きました。彼はそれを分解してやり直さなければなりませんでした。3時間かかりました。
items.answer: Kenji moved and built a bookshelf.
items.retell: Kenji moved to a new apartment last weekend. His friends helped with boxes, and he built a bookshelf.
items.retell_min: Kenji moved and built a bookshelf.

items.en: Aya loves reading, so she goes to the library every month. Last time, she borrowed three books about cooking. She read two of them quickly, but she forgot about the third one. When she remembered, the book was already five days late. She went to the library and paid a small fee. The librarian was kind and told her not to worry.
items.yaku: アヤは読書が大好きなので、毎月図書館に行きます。前回、彼女は料理に関する本を3冊借りました。2冊はすぐに読んだのですが、3冊目を忘れてしまいました。思い出したときには、その本はすでに5日遅れていました。彼女は図書館に行き、小さな料金を支払いました。司書は親切で、心配しないように言ってくれました。
items.answer: Aya borrowed books and paid a late fee.
items.retell: Aya goes to the library every month. She borrowed cooking books, and the librarian was kind when she paid a late fee.
items.retell_min: Aya borrowed books and paid a late fee.

items.en: Tell me two things a person can do to learn a new skill at work.
items.yaku: 職場で新しいスキルを学ぶためにできることを2つ教えてください。
items.answer: One way is to take online courses.
items.answer_full: One way is to take online courses. It helps because you can learn at your own pace. Another way is to ask colleagues for guidance.
items.a_yaku: 一つの方法は、オンラインコースを受けることです。

items.en: Do you prefer reading books or watching movies? Explain why.
items.yaku: 本を読むのと映画を見るの、どちらが好きですか。理由を教えてください。
items.answer: I prefer reading books.
items.answer_full: I prefer reading books. Because I can imagine the story in my mind. For example, when I read, I feel like I am in another world.
items.a_yaku: 私は本を読む方が好きです。

items.en: Do you prefer working in a team or working alone? Explain why.
items.yaku: チームで働くのと一人で働くの、どちらが好きですか。理由を教えてください。
items.answer: I prefer working in a team.
items.answer_full: I prefer working in a team. Because I can get new ideas from others. For example, teamwork helps me solve problems better.
items.a_yaku: 私はチームで働く方が好きです。
